name: nogyaan
description: State-Pruned Video Director & Storyboard MCP Server with DAG story branching, studio workbench, and diffusion model prompt compilation.

scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('dist/ui', {recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync('src/ui/studio-app.html', 'dist/ui/studio-app.html'); fs.cpSync('presets', 'dist/presets', {recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync('SKILL.md', 'dist/SKILL.md'); try { fs.chmodSync('dist/cli.js', 0o755); fs.chmodSync('dist/index.js', 0o755); } catch(e){}"
scripts.test: npm run build && node tests/run-verification.mjs && node tests/test-architecture-and-fixes.mjs && node tests/test-cli.mjs && node tests/test-stdio.mjs && node tests/test-system32-cwd.mjs && node tests/test-v2-architecture.mjs
